detail.title: Assumption Testing and Epistemological Self-Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Maintains active inquiry into assumption testing and epistemological self-correction.

children.title: Metareasoning and Resource Partitioning in Rational Agency

detail.title: Metareasoning and Resource Partitioning in Rational Agency
detail.summary: Rational agents face a metareasoning-partition problem, requiring the allocation of resources between solution planning and execution. Recent research suggests that metareasoning is critical for directing base-level problem solving, but interventions in AI-augmented reasoning must be context-aware to maintain cognitive flow and avoid disruption.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence regarding the metareasoning-partition problem and context-aware augmentation refines the scope of how an agent might self-correct.
